data.target_definition: Daily median of recorded positive quality-ok source/provider/GPU/instrument/tier/SKU/region/node groups. This is not an official target, persistent listing, or verified executed transaction. Null metadata stays null; ambiguous same-timestamp groups excluded before performance.
data.selection: Round-robin sorted provider/family/source groups with at least 20 past observations and three observed providers in their source/GPU/instrument/tier market. Metadata/data availability only; never model loss.

features.primary_group: source-specific other-provider within-group return context and observed collector composition
features.shared: Origin-safe own-price summaries in both arms
features.price_comparison_gate: Recorded nonmissing region and node agreement; unmatched dollar prices never pooled
features.return_context: Each return uses the same source-defined group at both dates before aggregation once per other provider. Cross-contract dollar levels are not compared.

training.selection: Lowest development seven-day pinball; checkpoint zero eligible; earliest update exact tie
training.learning_rate_selection: Fixed at v18 development-selected 0.0001, no new sweep

evaluation.historical_label: Retrospective, reused and dependent origins; no independent accuracy claim
evaluation.frozen_v18_control: No exact target match: new provider-group medians differ from v18 collector medians; do not reuse v18 scores as a matched control

future_protocol.classification: New individual-provider contract cohort; not the Pacific collector-median target
future_protocol.cohort_selection: Price-independent deterministic round-robin over sorted source-verified provider/family/contract identities with 30 retained observations; freeze at first eligible issuance; no replacements
future_protocol.model_lock: Immutable selected checkpoints and numerical state after readiness; no issuance before lock
future_protocol.truth: First retained compatible target-date source observation from the registered capture window, scored after target day ends; do not replace first vintage with revisions
future_protocol.primary_analysis: Paired seven-day mean dollar pinball on identical eligible contracts; origin clusters, shared shocks and repeated seed predictions are dependent; descriptive interim reporting only; no early promotion
future_protocol.uncertainty: Prespecified origin-block sensitivity; 16 origins are an initial panel, not an adequate-power assertion. Inconclusive results remain inconclusive. A later extension requires a separate registration.
future_protocol.promotion: At fixed final analysis, report paired loss and uncertainty versus price-only and preselected numerical reference. No automatic promotion from favorable interim scores. Median MAE, coverage, interval width and costs reported jointly.
future_protocol.fallback: Persistence for inference failures, retain failure flags; absent frozen origin contract or insufficient feature provenance prevents issuance; missing truth remains pending
future_protocol.existing_panels: v18 December6/February1, signals-v6, v8 and November23 gate unchanged
